scope: The 66 homepage criteria from the critical homepage review, in their original order. Payment integration is excluded.
advanceRule: Review all 66 criteria in original order using actual fictional-account journeys and an explicitly subjective expert persona appraisal. Latest user acceptance is either every score >=9.0 or the equal-weight mean of all 66 >=9.0; lower individual scores remain visible.
baselineMeaning: Earlier heuristic expert judgments of the reviewed homepage, not measured player outcomes and not current acceptance scores.
regressionRule: Meaningful build, server, browser, rating-integrity, privacy, keyboard, responsive, enlarged-text, contrast and reduced-motion checks accompany the change. A pass supports the implementation finding, while subjective scores remain the reviewer's judgments.

criteria.name: First impression
implementation: The opening passport shows a real accepted friend and a supported numerical comparison in the selected category.
A valid chosen comparison takes precedence. Otherwise the nearest estimate above, or the highest at or below, is shown.
Disconnected, provisional and pair-linked estimates are never used for an opening numerical comparison. Break mode removes comparison pressure.
Home placement states have a purposeful heading and actual five-result progress, with no provisional score or league.
The full circle is an accessible mobile disclosure. Lead updates remain visible outside the disclosure. Desktop retains the existing circle snapshot.
A friendless homepage uses one social invitation state rather than two repeated invitation cards.
engineeringGates: The primary recording action and relevant opening state render without horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 430, 768 and 1366 CSS pixels.
On a normal 390 by 844 phone viewport the named comparison fits above the persistent navigation.
Category changes, ties, chosen comparisons, unsupported evidence and breaks produce the correct context.
Placement states at zero, one, four and five confirmed results render actual progress without invented numbers.
Keyboard operation, focus visibility, 200 percent text, reduced motion and both appearance themes preserve usable actions.
The shared public passport presentation, existing match journeys and privacy boundaries remain covered by regression checks.

independentAcceptance.optionalFutureEvidence: Independent ordinary-phone appraisal of the opening's visual quality, personal relevance and immediate comprehension. A synthetic persona run cannot measure those perceptions.

criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The opening has a clear sporting identity, one prominent recording action and a genuine named comparison. The newcomer gets a purposeful five-match reveal instead of an empty dashboard.
criteria.remainingGap: The opening is calm and confident rather than cinematic; the feed starts below the first phone screen.

previousEngineeringVerification.limitations: Fictional local personas and Chrome viewport emulation. Does not measure physical-device, screen-reader or player-perception acceptance; no first-visit offline-boot guarantee.

criteria.name: Wow effect
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Separate blind AI expert appraisal of actual fictional-account screens and implementation; prior 56 grades retained. Subjective judgment, not player-reported outcomes.
criteria.finding: The passport now carries original shuttle artwork and earned seals land with a brief light sweep. The opening preserves its strong numeric focus; a crafted personal progress card extends that identity beyond the screen.
criteria.remainingGap: The opening passport and earned moments are polished, but the lower-page composition remains conventional.

criteria.name: Premium feel
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Consistent materials, authored typography, compact secondary actions and explicit real-match context make the screen feel considered. Error and placement states retain the same finish.
criteria.remainingGap: Some utility labels and initials-based portraits are less polished than the hero; a whole-product premium appraisal is outside this homepage score.

criteria.name: Brand distinctiveness
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The forest/ivory passport, shuttle-bearing seals, court lines and sporting number typography form a recognizable visual system. Group crests extend it into social context.
criteria.remainingGap: The white social-card convention is familiar and could carry a more distinctive SHUTTL detail.

criteria.name: Badminton identity
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Separate blind AI expert appraisal of actual fictional-account screens and implementation; prior 56 grades retained. Subjective judgment, not player-reported outcomes.
criteria.finding: A recognizable original shuttle illustration now lives in the hero and next-step surface, with real badminton categories, partnerships, local playing context and a coherent sporting progress report.
criteria.remainingGap: Badminton identity extends into the brief and export; the statistics presentation remains fairly general.

criteria.name: Rating-card visual quality
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: One dominant real number, legible status, original league seal, honest peak, reveal progress and an attached comparison make the passport an excellent focal object.
criteria.remainingGap: Long enlarged-text states occupy more height; the number still represents an estimate rather than certified skill.

criteria.name: Typography
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Manrope and Barlow separate functional reading from sporting numbers. Feed numbers align with concise names and outcomes, and long names wrap safely.
criteria.remainingGap: Tiny metadata is less effortless than the primary text; more languages would need a separate review.

criteria.name: Colour system
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Orange identifies recording, forest anchors the passport, and restrained earned accents distinguish milestones without recoloring every match. Checked dark states preserve this meaning.
criteria.remainingGap: Decorative gradients include contrast cases that automated tools cannot decide.

criteria.name: Spacing
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Shorter rating-guide wording keeps ordinary-phone secondary actions on one row. Compact feed facts and moved personal tools reduce blank or repetitive space.
criteria.remainingGap: Return notices and long group names legitimately add height; the first screen cannot show the entire social section.

criteria.name: Alignment
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Feed identity and numerical lanes align consistently, the hero retains one-line numbers, and enlarged text stacks those lanes deliberately.
criteria.remainingGap: Very long names create differing row heights, a reasonable readability tradeoff.

criteria.name: Depth and materials
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Subtle borders, forest gradients and seal glass provide separation and depth without heavy effects. Recovery notices use the same materials.
criteria.remainingGap: Feed surfaces have less crafted depth than the passport and remain conventional.

criteria.name: Icons and league badges
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Original shuttle-bearing league marks distinguish tiers by form and label. Group crests, refresh and share actions are consistently small and purposeful.
criteria.remainingGap: Small-size desirability and memorability remain reviewer judgments; there is no player customization in scope.

criteria.name: Dark mode
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Checked light and dark flows keep the main rating, buttons, feed outcomes and secondary labels legible; dark recording hover now has explicit colors.
criteria.remainingGap: Physical OLED behavior and every gradient contrast case have not been measured.

criteria.name: Desktop composition
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Desktop retains a balanced passport/competition column and a compact social column. Personal tools stay with the passport and feed stories have stronger numeric structure.
criteria.remainingGap: Column lengths still differ when one player has little activity or many review duties.

criteria.name: Animation quality
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Separate blind AI expert appraisal of actual fictional-account screens and implementation; prior 56 grades retained. Subjective judgment, not player-reported outcomes.
criteria.finding: Earned seals have a finite 650ms landing and 850ms light sweep, with bounded once-per-document milestone recognition. The original shuttle settles gently; live reduced motion removes these effects while leaving the actual number unchanged.
criteria.remainingGap: Purposeful finite motion and reduced-motion support remain good; no material new motion vocabulary was added in the final refinement.

criteria.name: Visual restraint
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The screen privileges the rating, recording and real people. Routine wins no longer receive repetitive promotional headlines; achievements alone get extra emphasis.
criteria.remainingGap: Several honest evidence labels remain because the rating is developing.

criteria.name: Purpose understanding
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The newcomer opening says see your level and follow your friends; category, recording and the five-confirmed-match reveal make the core purpose explicit.
criteria.remainingGap: A player must still open the rating guide to understand the full confirmation and comparison rules.

criteria.name: Information priority
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Rating and recording remain first; relevant comparison, review duties and earned moments precede utility links. The social feed is now factual and compact.
criteria.remainingGap: A returning player with new activity and reviews has a longer opening.

criteria.name: Simplicity
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: One record action, three independent categories, one collapsed circle and one social feed keep the primary structure understandable. Newcomers see one invitation path.
criteria.remainingGap: The distinction between published ratings and supported comparisons still requires a short explanation.

criteria.name: Information density
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The default feed contains three whole-match stories, with a direct show-more path. Facts replace repeated headlines; phone circle detail remains optional.
criteria.remainingGap: An all-play story with several accepted friends is denser than a single-person story.

criteria.name: Mobile first screen
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: At ordinary phone size the recording action, category, rating, milestone progress and named comparison fit in the opening view. The next actions follow immediately.
criteria.remainingGap: The feed requires scrolling; at 320px with 200% text the opening is deliberately taller.

criteria.name: Recording prominence
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The full-width orange Record a match action is conspicuous on phones and remains distinct on desktop, with a truthful Continue draft state.
criteria.remainingGap: It is a single entry point; there is no persistent floating duplicate.

criteria.name: Recording wording
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Record a match uses ordinary player language consistently on the home action and its dialog. Continue draft clearly identifies saved work.
criteria.remainingGap: Inside the flow, the rating unit and series-format rules require additional explanation.

criteria.name: Frequent-function access
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Recording, rating guide, history, sharing, comparisons, insights, goals and local players are reachable from home with purposeful labels.
criteria.remainingGap: Profile settings remain a separate destination, appropriate for an infrequent task.

criteria.name: Rating-category switching
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Singles, doubles and mixed retain independent scores and placement. Opening another category from a friend story no longer changes the home selection.
criteria.remainingGap: A three-way category choice remains an extra decision for newcomers.

criteria.name: Feed-filter clarity
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: All play and the selected-category activity filter have distinct selected states and clear accessible names. Category changes reset the visible story count.
criteria.remainingGap: Only all play and the current rating category are offered; arbitrary multi-category feed selection is absent.

criteria.name: Microcopy
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: New copy distinguishes one-partner estimates, disconnected playing groups, honest reveal progress, stale data and device-scoped return checks.
criteria.remainingGap: Some evidence language remains more technical than everyday badminton conversation.

criteria.name: Reading effort
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Dates, category, result direction and post-result numbers are scannable without repeated generic headings. Current comparison movement is one plain sentence.
criteria.remainingGap: Confirmation and comparison qualifications add necessary reading.

criteria.name: Secondary-function discovery
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Share passport is next to history; insights, goals and local players are before the feed in the main column. Named groups link directly to their details.
criteria.remainingGap: Secondary tools still sit below the core rating on phones.

criteria.name: First-use understanding
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: An actual zero-match account gets a purposeful reveal card, five visible steps, an immediate record action and a single route to find friends. No numbers are fabricated.
criteria.remainingGap: Five results is a meaningful initial effort; the home alone does not teach every approval rule.

criteria.name: Competitive immediacy
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: A real comparable friend is attached to the opening rating, current lead updates are visible, and actual movement since the previous check adds urgency when warranted.
criteria.remainingGap: Cold networks or fixed partnerships cannot provide honest numerical rivalry immediately.

criteria.name: Friend-position clarity
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The circle shows ties accurately, a friends-only position and the population being compared. Unsupported players are excluded with a specific reason.
criteria.remainingGap: It is an order of developing comparable estimates, not a certified ranking.

criteria.name: Who is ahead on mobile
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The named friend, actual category and point gap are visible on the phone passport without expanding the circle. The chosen valid friend takes priority.
criteria.remainingGap: The opening highlights one person rather than all possible rivals.

criteria.name: Lead relevance and coverage
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: New-match publication batches can generate a genuine crossing notice. Home filters obsolete crossings and displays the present gap and dated context.
criteria.remainingGap: Late backfills and correction replays deliberately do not create fresh lead pressure.

criteria.name: Since-last-visit clarity
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: A real new published match is counted once even when two friends appear in it. New versus updated stories and saved acknowledgement persist through reload.
criteria.remainingGap: This context belongs to one account on one device and is limited to the loaded recent snapshot.

criteria.name: Defending a lead
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The opening can show a narrowing lead, a closed gap or a genuine crossing from prior supported estimates, giving a leading player relevant context.
criteria.remainingGap: It does not predict how many wins will defend a lead or create an artificial challenge deadline.

criteria.name: Next milestone
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The next actual league threshold and remaining points are clear on the rating card, alongside the genuine personal best and optional personal goal.
criteria.remainingGap: Points to a threshold are not a guaranteed number of games.

criteria.name: Neighbourhood relevance
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Separate blind AI expert appraisal of actual fictional-account screens and implementation; prior 56 grades retained. Subjective judgment, not player-reported outcomes.
criteria.finding: The home shows actual opted-in local presence, declared area, recorded recent play and published estimates without inventing a rank. Local names can open an accepted friend comparison or an explicit, privacy-respecting connection request with pending-state continuity.
criteria.remainingGap: A named accepted local connection and direct comparison make the area actionable; selection is basic rather than tailored to playing context.

criteria.name: Honest comparisons
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Same category and shared evidence are required, placement numbers are hidden, and real one-partner accounts have an explicit limit instead of a misleading rank.
criteria.remainingGap: The shipped pilot model has not been calibrated against a real badminton dataset; this score concerns honest comparison presentation.

criteria.name: Chosen-comparison control
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: A saved accepted friend controls the opening comparison when supported, and remains identified with an explanation when direct comparison is unavailable.
criteria.remainingGap: The preference is device-scoped and does not synchronize across phones.

criteria.name: Reducing pressure
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Break mode removes competitive pressure while retaining the rating, real activity and ordinary actions. Missing evidence never gets a fake title or urgency countdown.
criteria.remainingGap: Individual emotional responses vary; this is an appraisal of the implemented controls.

criteria.name: Overall FOMO mechanisms
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Separate blind AI expert appraisal of actual fictional-account screens and implementation; prior 56 grades retained. Subjective judgment, not player-reported outcomes.
criteria.finding: Actual friend movement and new activity now have an active recognition loop: a friend can congratulate a genuine reveal, league crossing or peak and the recipient sees it privately. Local connection paths and a personal next marker make the competitive context actionable.
criteria.remainingGap: Genuine milestones and peer movement provide return motives; newcomer pull remains limited without connections and fresh confirmed play.

criteria.name: Real-people presence
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Actual accepted players appear with names, avatars and category-specific progress, and real named groups have their own crests and identities.
criteria.remainingGap: Initials are common when players have not added portraits.

criteria.name: Activity meaning
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Stories identify the category, local date, win or loss, published post-result score, visible delta and genuine milestone. Shared friends remain together as one match.
criteria.remainingGap: Foreign match games and rosters are intentionally unavailable to the viewer.

criteria.name: Feed scanability
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The number lane, plain outcome labels, compact local dates and achievement-only headings let a player scan several stories quickly.
criteria.remainingGap: Four-friend shared matches remain taller, especially with large text.

criteria.name: Feed variety
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Separate blind AI expert appraisal of actual fictional-account screens and implementation; prior 56 grades retained. Subjective judgment, not player-reported outcomes.
criteria.finding: The feed now offers an all-category milestone view and distinct private incoming recognition in addition to routine and shared match stories. Whole-match grouping, factual dates and older pagination remain intact.
criteria.remainingGap: Milestones and routine results look different, but much of the content still repeats participant/rating rows.

criteria.name: Belonging
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Named badminton groups, actual crests, accepted member counts and direct group access make the home feel connected to a real playing circle.
criteria.remainingGap: Belonging still depends on peers joining and using the app; group rituals beyond existing recaps are limited.

criteria.name: Social-privacy presentation
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Home explains its accepted-friend audience; blocked people are excluded, foreign result details stay private, and public sharing requires the existing explicit controls.
criteria.remainingGap: Public snapshots remain captured records and must be revoked through the provided controls.

criteria.name: Reciprocity
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Separate blind AI expert appraisal of actual fictional-account screens and implementation; prior 56 grades retained. Subjective judgment, not player-reported outcomes.
criteria.finding: Accepted friends can congratulate an actually published milestone even when they did not play in that match. The recipient can revisit their own result from private recognition. Exact-request retry, revision checks, blocks, export and deletion protect the loop; there are no rating points or public counters.
criteria.remainingGap: Private recognition closes an actual loop; ordinary acknowledgement is less immediate than comparison.

criteria.name: Earned-reward credibility
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Rewards derive from confirmed published reveal, league crossing or genuine peak. A newer routine result no longer wipes a still-recent earned moment; pending corrections are not celebrated.
criteria.remainingGap: League desirability is an expert appraisal rather than a measured willingness to play more.

criteria.name: Milestone discovery
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Recent own achievements stay visible on home and friend milestones have distinct headlines, seals and factual labels in the feed.
criteria.remainingGap: The dedicated recent own moment has a seven-day window and uses loaded history.

criteria.name: Sharing discovery
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: A published player has Share passport alongside rating guide and history, opening the actual preview/privacy/export flow. Unrated accounts do not get a fake rating share.
criteria.remainingGap: Some social destinations require download and posting outside the app.

criteria.name: Loss support
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Separate blind AI expert appraisal of actual fictional-account screens and implementation; prior 56 grades retained. Subjective judgment, not player-reported outcomes.
criteria.finding: A recent loss gets a calm next-step surface linking that exact match to the wider personal brief. The brief shows actual trajectory, current status, period outcomes and a personal marker, and explains developing estimates rather than implying a loss diagnoses technique.
criteria.remainingGap: Honest chart scale and actual-result links improve context; guidance remains general rather than an individualized next action.

criteria.name: Quiet-week value
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Separate blind AI expert appraisal of actual fictional-account screens and implementation; prior 56 grades retained. Subjective judgment, not player-reported outcomes.
criteria.finding: An actual player with five older published matches gets an honest quiet-week next step. They can switch from an empty seven-day window to their real career trace, revisit goals and playing relationships, or keep a private progress card without a required streak.
criteria.remainingGap: Connections, result journal, career history and export add substantive quiet-week review; depth depends on recorded history and selected discipline.

criteria.name: Visible premium-value differentiation
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Separate blind AI expert appraisal of actual fictional-account screens and implementation; prior 56 grades retained. Subjective judgment, not player-reported outcomes.
criteria.finding: The visible proposition now includes a period-comparison toolkit, chosen-player matchup histories, an evidence-linked league collection, personal next markers, optional accepted-friend rivalry and factual exports. The proposed membership distinguishes this depth from the current-rating foundation.
criteria.remainingGap: Price fit remains weaker for occasional players, sparse histories and inactive circles. Actual willingness to pay and retention remain unmeasured.

criteria.name: Recording-entry reliability
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: All persona accounts reach the actual recording dialog from home; category context, Escape and focus return are covered alongside existing submission/retry journeys.
criteria.remainingGap: This score covers the entry and tested recovery states, not unlimited network/device reliability.

criteria.name: Draft continuation
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: A live account-bound draft becomes Continue draft; prior conflict, interrupted-submission and navigation tests protect its original identity and exact payload.
criteria.remainingGap: Draft continuity depends on device storage and its explicit recovery handling.

criteria.name: Review-prompt correctness
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Home review prompts include active older results beyond the history page limit and exclude authors, already-approved players and covered teammates.
criteria.remainingGap: The active-results query is not a production-volume benchmark.

criteria.name: Account and private boundaries
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Account/session epochs plus a latest-refresh sequence prevent older requests from restoring another identity or overwriting a newer home snapshot. Existing privacy regressions remain covered.
criteria.remainingGap: The finite browser review is not a full security assessment.

criteria.name: Semantics and keyboard
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: New actions have semantic buttons, named category groups and explicit focus recovery after comparison, dialog closure and marking activity as seen.
criteria.remainingGap: A physical screen-reader and switch-control review has not been performed.

criteria.name: Large text
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The actual enlarged-text account uses 200% text at 320px without horizontal overflow. Names and feed number lanes stack, and recording remains reachable.
criteria.remainingGap: The opening and navigation become substantially taller; larger type cannot preserve the ordinary one-screen composition.

criteria.name: Checked contrast and legibility
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Checked light/dark states and every new persona home have no detected WCAG AA violations, with visible labels and restrained color-only meaning.
criteria.remainingGap: Automated indeterminate gradient nodes are retained; this is not a complete WCAG conformance claim.

criteria.name: Reduced motion
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: The motion preference removes story and number arrival animation without hiding content. The actual persona contexts use reduced motion successfully.
criteria.remainingGap: Motion sensitivity varies; a physical-device appraisal is outside this local review.

criteria.name: Freshness and recovery visibility
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Home persistently labels a failed refresh, retains the loaded court, offers explicit retry and shows a successful update time. Warm-shell navigation stalls are bounded.
criteria.remainingGap: Cold offline startup and hosted-network performance are not established.

criteria.name: Activity depth and continuity
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Whole-match pagination retains all accepted friends in a match, retries older-page failures and recovers changed cursors; recent shared results can open through real participation metadata.
criteria.remainingGap: The initial feed is a recent snapshot, not complete history; older loaded pages require refresh for later corrections.

criteria.name: No fabricated provisional score
criteria.acceptanceBasis: Latest user-authorized expert persona average; not independent player validation
criteria.finding: Actual zero-match, rated and five-match fixed-partnership accounts display the right independent-category states. No public number, league or delta appears before the required reveal.
criteria.remainingGap: Five results reveals a developing estimate, not calibrated certainty about skill.

previousRequirement.supersededForThisHomepageReviewBy: User explicitly authorizes simulated personas and either every criterion at 9.0 or the equal-weight average at 9.0. Actual outcome claims retain their evidence requirements.

scoreMeaning: One-decimal expert judgments of the implemented homepage through simulated player perspectives, not observations reported by real players or measured retention, willingness to pay or model calibration. Test pass counts do not mechanically determine these scores.

rubric.10: Exceptional execution with no material weakness observed in this defined scope. Not awarded in this review.
rubric.9_to_9_9: Excellent execution of the criterion in checked states: strong personal relevance, craft or usable control, with only limited residual weaknesses.
rubric.8_to_8_9: Strong but a meaningful limitation remains, such as limited emotional payoff, activity diversity or quiet-week pull.
rubric.7_to_7_9: Useful and improved, but substantial differentiation or evidence still limits the proposition.

reviewMethod.kind: Separate blind AI expert critique plus implemented fictional-persona journeys
reviewMethod.ratingSource: Actual local rating publisher and approved match APIs; persona ratings are not fabricated browser responses.
reviewMethod.perceptionSource: A separate AI reviewer inspected source and rendered screens before reading the draft grades. The final ten grades are used without raising them to a target. The earlier 56 are retained, so the aggregate combines the original appraisal with this stricter targeted review.
reviewMethod.scopeLimit: Homepage criteria only. Original 150-criterion outcome register and measured D7/D30, model calibration and willingness-to-pay values are unchanged.

summary.weighting: Equal weight for all 66, including every low grade. Prior 56 grades retained; ten reappraised by a separate reviewer.
summary.interpretation: The average option remains met as a subjective point estimate; this is not individual9.0/9.5 acceptance. The Studio price-value target7.0 has a separate expert score7.2.
